checks.name: error envelope and safety statuses

checks.name: capture and upload consent boundary

checks.name: assist lease and stop boundary
checks.detail: assist join is device/grant scoped and assist end requires local stop before server lease fallback

checks.name: stream and event termination coverage
checks.detail: stream operations and explicit cancel/stop operations are represented separately

checks.name: pet and reminder safety boundaries
checks.detail: pet application remains preview-confirmed/versioned and reminder receipts do not equate send with seen

checks.name: all operations await D before implementation
checks.detail: generated operations are marked E-after-D-approval and cannot be read as deployed backend behavior
